mission.posting: Kellis Biotech is an internationally recognized, full service original equipment manufacturer (OEM) specializing in medical and cosmetic devices. From design to large scale production, Kellis is industry leading in the creation of medical grade hardware, specializing in embedded micro-devices and operating equipment. Our standards are matched by our approach, which only accepts absolute reliability and stability - because when it comes to your health, we refuse to compromise on quality.
